project.name: Life Atlas
project.productType: private geographic biography and social memory product

must: Keep the Mapbox globe as the visual and interaction centerpiece.
Preserve the warm ivory, copper, sage and editorial typography identity.
Preserve Movement Fingerprint as a product visualization.
Use real profile photos when available and rectangular initial tiles otherwise.
Keep mobile primary actions reachable with a compact bottom navigation.
Treat Friends-only, individual Private overrides, and external sharing as visibly distinct privacy concepts.
avoid: Oversized headings that create empty screens.
Nested cards for simple rows or repeated permission panels.
Replacing real geography with decorative map approximations.
Introducing a second design system or cool corporate palette.

decisions: Adapted interaction patterns from 21st.dev Interactive Timeline, Filmstrip Gallery, Masonry Lightbox, Bottom Nav Bar, Team Profile Grid, Location Card and Map Controls while retaining Life Atlas styling.
Chapter timelines use a strong active rail, larger photographic previews and direct editing actions.
Life Circle is a compact people-and-requests workspace, not a dashboard of permission cards.
Our Paths leads with the combined globe and uses distinct copper, blue and violet routes with a shared-place gold.
Share cards use the bundled Natural Earth 110m geometry and never include personal photographs unless a future explicit opt-in is provided.
